meta.currency: mean-ablation (per-position held mean) delta cross-entropy per valid held position (nats), paired SE
meta.forward: VERBATIM qk_mlp_superposition.py (project-out mean-ablation) + class library VERBATIM qk_unsup_classpush.py
meta.classify_rule: clear = trigger_dCE_z>=3 & trigger_dCE>=0.02. class_pusher/suppressor: class_concentration>=0.45 (single class holds >=45% of abs class-summed movement), sign of pushed class. sharp_token: top10 token share>=0.5. diffuse_distributed: clear but neither. null_subthreshold: not clear. INTERPRETABLE = {class_pusher, class_suppressor, sharp_token}.

meta.category_eval: 6-way next-token category probe (ridge, fixed intact readout), adapted qk_category_engine.py

induction.note: advantage = mean CE(first occ) - mean CE(second occ) on repeated sequences; higher=stronger induction. ret = fraction of (intact - allMLP1ablated) advantage retained.
